The '''Dwarvish Safety Manual''' is a power [[Books|book]] that can be purchased from the [[Dwarf]]'s shop for {{Price|4000}}. It can also be purchased from the [[Bookseller]] for {{Price|20000}} starting in Year 3 (≈9% chance to appear).<ref name="y3chance" />

The first reading grants the player a power that reduces the damage of [[Crafting#Bombs|bombs]] to the player by 25%. Once read, it can be found in [[the Player]]'s Menu on the [[Special Items & Powers]] tab. Each subsequent reading gives the player 100 [[Mining]] [[Skills|XP]].

==Bundles==
Dwarvish Safety Manual is not used in any [[bundles]].

==Tailoring==
Dwarvish Safety Manual is not used in any [[tailoring]]. It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a red dye at the dye pots located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]]. It can also be used as a red dye when used in the spool of the [[Sewing Machine]] with a dyeable clothing item in the feed.

==Quests==
Dwarvish Safety Manual is not used in any [[quests]].
